name: k6-operator

metadata.name: k6-operator
metadata.description: A Helm chart for the k6 operator

manifest:
---
# Source: k6-operator/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: k6-operator-controller-manager
  namespace: perf
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-operator
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-operator
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-operator
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: manager
          image: ghcr.io/grafana/k6-operator:controller-v0.0.19

name: checkout-loadtest

metadata.name: k6-test
metadata.description: Runs a k6 load test as a Kubernetes Job

manifest:
---
# Source: k6-test/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: checkout-loadtest-script
  namespace: perf
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-test
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: checkout-loadtest
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: k6-test-0.4.2
data:
  script.js: |
    import http from 'k6/http';
    export const options = { vus: 400, duration: '45m' };
    export default function () { http.post('http://checkout-web.checkout.svc:3000/api/checkout', JSON.stringify({ cart: 'load-test' })); }
---
# Source: k6-test/templates/job.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: checkout-loadtest
  namespace: perf
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-test
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: checkout-loadtest
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: k6-test-0.4.2
spec:
  parallelism: 4
  completions: 4
  backoffLimit: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-test
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: checkout-loadtest
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: k6
          image: grafana/k6:0.52.0
          args: ["run", "--vus", "200", "/scripts/script.js"]
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              memory: 1Gi

  completions: 2
  backoffLimit: 0

      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: k6-test
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: search-loadtest
